label: HFS hospital reimbursement
secondarySource: Illinois HFS Transparency Law Provider-Level Data
attachGoal: Attach Illinois hospital Medicaid rate sheet and provider-level payment records.
canProve: Published Medicaid hospital rate context and aggregate HFS payment flow where the public files include the facility.
cannotProve: Claim-level payment, managed-care contract terms, patient severity, denials, or actual allowed amount for a specific encounter.
nextAction: Review lower-confidence HFS provider-payment matches, then rerun this importer when HFS publishes the next provider-level Transparency Law file.

label: Machine-readable price file
secondarySource: Taylorville Memorial Hospital standard charges CSV
attachGoal: Find payer/plan rates for DRG, CPT/HCPCS, revenue-code, pharmacy, lab, imaging, ED, and observation examples.
canProve: Gross charge, cash price, min/max negotiated-rate, and selected payer/plan price signals when parsed.
cannotProve: Actual reimbursement, public payer payment, claim volume, medical necessity, denials, patient responsibility, or margin.
nextAction: Expand the price parser to extract payer-specific negotiated columns, not only gross-charge preview examples.

label: Cost report economics
primarySource: Illinois HFS Medicaid Hospital Archive Cost Reports
attachGoal: Attach CMS HCRIS revenue, expense, utilization, wage, cost-to-charge, and margin fields.
canProve: Reported facility cost, charge, utilization, wage, bed, and cost-center economics from required cost reports.
cannotProve: Exact service-line profitability, real-time liquidity, commercial contract profitability, or system subsidy flows without more disclosures.
nextAction: Use the statewide HCRIS attachment to compare cost, charge, utilization, staffing, and margin signals across hospitals; next, add Illinois HFS cost report archive rows where they expose Medicaid-specific cost context.

label: Clinical reimbursement bridge
primarySource: Illinois HFS Hospital Inpatient reimbursement logic
secondarySource: CMS MS-DRG classifications and IPPS rules
attachGoal: Attach DRG/APR-DRG, LOS, transfer, outlier, HAC/POA, and readmission logic.
canProve: How diagnosis/procedure groupers, length of stay, transfer status, high-cost outliers, POA/HAC, and readmission logic can affect payment under specific rules.
cannotProve: Whether a particular encounter was coded correctly or paid correctly without claim, medical-record, and payer adjudication data.
nextAction: Create test clinical scenarios for ED-to-observation, ED-to-inpatient, transfer, readmission, and complication/HAC risk.
